About our brand and products:
VoltaWell is a hydration and electrolyte brand built around a different idea: hydration begins at the cell. Our flagship product, Volta HYDRATE, supports athletes, active adults, wellness professionals, and everyday people who want hydration that goes beyond ordinary water and salt.

What makes us different:
Most electrolyte products focus mainly on sodium. Volta HYDRATE provides a balanced electrolyte blend designed to support fluid balance, cellular hydration, energy, performance, recovery, and daily wellness.

How affiliates can earn:
Approved affiliates can earn commission by sharing VoltaWell with their audience, clients, athletes, wellness communities, and personal networks. We are looking for aligned partners who believe hydration is one of the most overlooked foundations of health and performance.

How to promote us:
Affiliates may promote VoltaWell through educational content, social media, blogs, communities, direct links, email to opted-in audiences, and authentic product storytelling. We do not allow spam, coupon scraping, misleading claims, paid search bidding on VoltaWell terms, or unauthorized paid ads.

Other information:
VoltaWell is direct-to-consumer and ambassador-driven. We test, we educate, and we are building a community around better hydration.

Effective Date 4-22-2026

Introduction

Welcome to the VoltaWell Partner Program.

By creating an account and participating in the program, you agree to the terms outlined in this

agreement. These terms are designed to ensure a fair, transparent, and high integrity partnership for

everyone involved.

How the Program Works

VoltaWell Partners earn commissions based on a three tier structure:

10% on your personal retail sales

5% on second tier sales

2.5% on third tier sales

As a partner, you are automatically qualified to earn across all three levels.

Commissions apply to qualifying purchases made through your referral link as determined by

VoltaWell’s tracking systems.

VoltaWell reserves the right to classify partners into different categories, tiers, or program types at its

discretion. These classifications may include different commission structures, requirements, benefits,

or restrictions based on performance, role, or promotional channel.

Product Experience Requirement

VoltaWell is a performance-based product built on real-world results and personal experience.

To maintain the integrity of the program, partners are expected to have firsthand experience with the

product.

A qualifying purchase is required before commissions can be earned.

This ensures partners can speak authentically about the product and represent the brand accurately.

VoltaWell reserves the right to suspend or remove accounts that have not met this requirement.

Payments

Commissions are paid monthly within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. The minimum

payout threshold is 100 dollars. Earnings below this amount will roll over to the next payout period.

Once your annual earnings reach 600 dollars, you are required to submit a W-9. Payments may be

withheld but will continue to accrue until proper documentation is received.Commission Adjustments

Commissions are calculated based on net sales. Net sales exclude taxes, shipping, processing fees,

and any amounts associated with refunds, returns, chargebacks, or canceled transactions.

VoltaWell reserves the right to adjust, reduce, or reverse commissions to reflect the final net value of

a transaction. This includes any refunds, returns, chargebacks, cancellations, or other post-sale

adjustments.

VoltaWell reserves the right to review and reverse commissions associated with patterns of excessive

returns, cancellations, disputed transactions, or abnormal purchasing behavior.

All commission calculations and adjustments are determined by VoltaWell at its sole discretion.

Attribution and Referral Credit

Referral credit is determined based on VoltaWell’s tracking systems. Last-click attribution applies

unless otherwise determined by VoltaWell. VoltaWell’s tracking system is the final authority on

referral attribution. Discrepancies due to browser settings, device switching, ad blockers, or customer

behavior are not guaranteed to be corrected.

Program Rules

These rules are strictly enforced to protect the integrity of the brand and the program.

Claims and Representations

No medical claims are allowed. You may not state or imply that VoltaWell products diagnose, treat,

cure, or prevent any disease.

No income claims are allowed. You may not represent or imply guaranteed earnings or income

potential.

You must represent VoltaWell products honestly. No false claims, exaggerated benefits, or

misleading statements are permitted.

Partners may not position VoltaWell products in a misleading or comparative way that distorts the

intended use or scientific positioning of the product.

Disclosure and Marketing Compliance

Partners must clearly disclose their relationship with VoltaWell when promoting products. This

includes complying with FTC guidelines for endorsements and testimonials.

No spam or unsolicited marketing is allowed. All email, SMS, and messaging-based marketing must

comply with applicable laws including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and other relevant regulations. Partners

are responsible for obtaining proper consent before contacting individuals.

Advertising and promotional materials may require prior approval. When in doubt, seek approval

before publishing.

Brand and Intellectual Property

Brand and trademark use must be accurate. You may not use VoltaWell or any related trademarks indomains, usernames, ads, or links that could mislead users. You may not present yourself as the

company or imply official sponsorship.

Partners may not create, distribute, or promote derivative content, frameworks, or programs that

replicate or repackage VoltaWell’s proprietary positioning, messaging, or educational concepts as

their own. This includes, but is not limited to, using VoltaWell’s language, frameworks, or unique

concepts to build competing offers, programs, or branded systems without prior written approval.

Program Structure and Tracking

Wholesale accounts are excluded from standard commissions due to negotiated pricing. VoltaWell

may offer a one-time referral payment at its discretion.

Referral tracking depends on your partner link. Encouraging customers to create accounts improves

tracking accuracy. Guest checkout may result in missed commissions.

Customer Complaints and Partner Conduct

Partners are expected to represent VoltaWell accurately and interact with customers in a professional

and responsible manner.

Any customer complaints related to misleading claims, poor communication, aggressive marketing, or

misrepresentation of the product may be reviewed by VoltaWell.

Partners may be required to correct or remove misleading content, address customer concerns

appropriately, and cooperate with VoltaWell in resolving issues.

VoltaWell reserves the right to reverse associated commissions, suspend or terminate accounts, and

restrict participation in the program.

Repeated complaints or patterns of behavior that negatively impact customer experience or brand

reputation may result in immediate removal from the program.

VoltaWell’s determination of what constitutes misleading or inappropriate conduct is final.

VoltaWell reserves the right to remove, restrict, or terminate any partner whose actions, content,

positioning, or overall representation are deemed inconsistent with the brand or potentially harmful to

its reputation, at its sole discretion, regardless of whether a specific rule has been violated.

Additional Program Protections

Unauthorized discounting or coupon use is not permitted. You may not offer incentives, rebates, or

discounts that are not approved by VoltaWell.

Partners may not list, distribute, or promote VoltaWell links or offers on coupon, deal, cashback, or

browser extension platforms without prior written approval. This includes coupon websites, discount

aggregators, and browser-based shopping tools.

Partners may not create sub-affiliate networks, resell access to the program, or allow third parties to

operate under their account without prior written approval.All referred transactions must be completed through VoltaWell’s official website, systems, or

approved sales channels. Partners may not direct, encourage, or facilitate purchases outside of

VoltaWell’s official channels for the purpose of bypassing tracking, commissions, or pricing structures.

Any attempt to circumvent VoltaWell’s systems, including off-platform transactions or side

arrangements, may result in reversal of commissions, account termination, and removal from the

program.

Self-Referral and Commission Abuse

You may not earn commissions on your own purchases, purchases made on your behalf, or

purchases made using accounts you control directly or indirectly.

This includes, but is not limited to creating multiple accounts, referring yourself through alternate

emails or identities, placing orders through your own link, or coordinating purchases through friends,

family, or controlled parties for the purpose of earning commissions.

Any attempt to generate commissions through self-referral or manipulation of the referral system is

strictly prohibited.

Violations will result in immediate termination, forfeiture of all unpaid commissions, and potential

removal of associated accounts.

VoltaWell reserves the right to determine what constitutes self-referral or abuse at its sole discretion.

Structural Manipulation and Multi-Tier Abuse

You may not structure, participate in, or benefit from any arrangement designed to capture multiple

tiers of commission from the same underlying purchasing activity.

This includes, but is not limited to:

 creating or controlling multiple partner accounts across tiers

 organizing or coordinating accounts in a vertical structure where the majority of sales originate

from a single downstream account

 directing or consolidating purchasing activity through a specific account for the purpose of

generating multi-tier commissions

Partner networks must reflect legitimate, independent participants generating their own activity.

VoltaWell uses internal monitoring systems to identify abnormal account structures and purchasing

patterns.

VoltaWell reserves the right to review account relationships, purchasing patterns, and network

structures. Any arrangement that, in VoltaWell’s sole judgment, appears designed to artificially

capture multi-tier commissions may result in:

 reversal of commissions

 account suspension or termination

 removal of associated accounts

All determinations are final.Advertising

Paid Advertising Restrictions

To protect the VoltaWell brand, pricing integrity, and partner fairness, the following paid advertising

rules apply:

Brand Bidding

You may not bid on, target, or purchase ads using VoltaWell branded terms without prior written

approval. This includes VoltaWell, Volta Hydrate, any product names, trademarks, or misspellings or

variations of these terms on search engines or any paid advertising platform.

Partners are responsible for ensuring that VoltaWell branded terms are excluded from their

campaigns, including the use of negative keyword matching where applicable.

Ad Representation

You may not create ads that appear to represent VoltaWell directly or imply that you are the

company.

Traffic Routing

You may not send paid traffic directly to your affiliate link without prior written approval.

All paid traffic must first be directed to your own content, website, or landing page, where you provide

context, education, or personal experience before linking to VoltaWell.

Organic and Content-Based Promotion

VoltaWell encourages partners to promote products through organic content, including social media

posts, short-form video, long-form video, podcasts, blogs, and other educational or experience-based

formats.

Partners may freely create and distribute content discussing hydration, performance, recovery, or

related topics, and may include VoltaWell as part of that content, provided all other program rules are

followed.

This includes personal experiences, reviews, educational content, and performance-based use

cases.

Examples of Permitted and Prohibited Activity

Not allowed:

Running ads for VoltaWell or similar branded terms

Running ads that redirect directly to your affiliate link

Creating ads that appear to be official VoltaWell promotions

Allowed:

Creating content about hydration, performance, or recovery and linking to VoltaWell

Running ads to your own website, blog, or video where you discuss your experience

Educational or review-based content that introduces VoltaWell as part of your message

VoltaWell reserves the right to determine what constitutes a violation of these advertising policies.

Violations may result in removal from the program and forfeiture of commissions.Content Usage Rights

By participating in the program, you grant VoltaWell the right to use and share content you create

related to the brand for marketing purposes.

Partners are solely responsible for the content they create and distribute. VoltaWell is not liable for

any claims, damages, or issues arising from partner-created content.

Inactivity

Partners are expected to maintain reasonable levels of activity and engagement with the program.

Activity may include generating sales, referring new customers or partners, or otherwise participating

in the program in a meaningful way.

Accounts that show prolonged inactivity, lack of meaningful engagement, or patterns of stagnation

within their network structure may be reviewed, restricted, or removed from the program at

VoltaWell’s discretion.

VoltaWell reserves the right to evaluate partner activity, account structure, and contribution to the

program when determining continued eligibility.

Fraud and Abuse

Any attempt to manipulate or exploit the affiliate system will result in immediate termination and

forfeiture of all unpaid commissions.

This includes but is not limited to fake purchases, incentivized transactions, misuse of links, or any

attempt to game the system.

Right to Withhold Commissions

VoltaWell reserves the right to withhold or deny commissions for any reason including suspected

fraud, policy violations, abnormal purchasing behavior, or misuse of the referral system.

All determinations are made at VoltaWell’s sole discretion.

Independent Relationship

Partners are independent contractors and not employees, agents, or representatives of VoltaWell.

You may not act on behalf of VoltaWell, bind the company, or represent yourself as official staff.

Disputes

VoltaWell will make reasonable efforts to resolve commission disputes in good faith. Decisions made

by VoltaWell regarding commissions and attribution are final.Legal and Venue

Any disputes arising from participation in the program will be resolved through binding arbitration in

Orange County, Florida.

Limitation of Liability

VoltaWell is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, including loss of income, lost

opportunity, or tracking errors.

Participation in the program is at your own risk.

Termination

VoltaWell reserves the right to terminate any partner account at any time, with or without cause.

Unpaid commissions may be forfeited in cases of violation, abuse, or suspected misconduct.

Program Changes

VoltaWell reserves the right to modify the commission structure, program terms, or rules at any time.

Updates will take effect immediately upon posting.
